description: Retrieve a stored credential from the vault by name. Only returns credentials owned by the authenticated user. The value is MASKED by default; pass reveal:true only if the user explicitly asked for the raw secret.

name.description: Credential name as used in vault_store_credential

reveal.description: Return the full secret. Default false: the value is masked (first/last 2 chars). Only set true when the user explicitly asked to see the secret.

name: vault_get_credential
